note: #5811 (Drebbel's self-regulating oven), job drebbel-oven-5811, 2026-10-04. Printed witnesses from Keller, Nuncius 28 (2013). Every id was confirmed against the item's own _djvu.txt: the Drebbel/Kuffler passage is present and the volume was identified from its text, not from IA's title metadata. All are imported HELD and released into envelope drebbel-oven-5811 one at a time, in brief priority order. Not imported: Jaeger 1922 (not on IA; DBNL has no title page for it; no Delpher importer exists) and Sorbière's Paris 1664 edition (Gallica 429 from Hetzner; the 1666 Cologne printing is used instead).

BOOKS.title: Journal des voyages de Monsieur de Monconys … Seconde partie (Voyage d'Angleterre, Païs-Bas, Allemagne & Italie)
BOOKS.author: Monconys, Balthazar de
BOOKS.note: #5811 priority 1. Lyon, Boissat & Remeus 1666, Part II (the text reads 'SECONDE PARTIE'). Visit to 'Docteur Keiffer gendre de M. Drebel' at Stratford-Bow (1663). Part III's index cites 'Four de Drebel qui cuit en 24 heures 2000 L. de pain, p.54' (Keller: p.54, Wren's reproduction of Drebbel's oven). Naples copy, Google scan. CORRECTION after import: the held stub 6a44359d0235c9147000dd12, titled 'Première partie', is ALSO Part II (Lausanne copy; its title page reads SECONDE PARTIE). This import is therefore a second copy of that part: held as duplicate-copy-awaits-derek-5811, 0 pages OCR'd.

BOOKS.title: Journal des voyages de Monsieur de Monconys … Première partie (Voyage de Portugal, Provence, Italie, Egypte, Syrie, Constantinople & Natolie)
BOOKS.author: Monconys, Balthazar de
BOOKS.note: #5811 priority 1, the brief's 'vol I'. Lyon, Boissat & Remeus 1665, Part I (the title page reads 'PREMIERE PARTIE'). Printed pp.40–41: 'Le 31. Ie vis le matin m. Merendiere, ses Fourneaux & inuention de donner le feu au degré qu'il veut' (Keller n.27). Naples copy (Bibl. Naz. Vittorio Emanuele III), Google scan. This is the one part of the three that was not held.

BOOKS.title: The Diary of John Evelyn, Esq., F.R.S. (Bray/Wheatley ed., 1906), Vol. II
BOOKS.author: Evelyn, John
BOOKS.note: #5811 priority 2. London, Bickers & Son 1906: the same edition as the held vol. III + index, 6a08f61e50bd891addfba9dc, whose index reads 'Drebbell, chemist, ii. 198; Keffler, Dr., ii. 198'. Printed p.198 (Aug. 1st 1666): 'I went to Dr. Keffler, who married ye daughter of ye famous chymist Drebbell … to see his yron ovens'. IA's title metadata says 'Volume IV'; the text shows it is vol. II. University of Michigan copy, Google scan.

BOOKS.title: Appendix to the Reference Index of Patents of Invention, from 1617 to 1852
BOOKS.author: Woodcroft, Bennet
BOOKS.note: #5811 priority 3. London 1855. Printed p.16: A.D. 1634 No. 75, Prusen and Strachy, 'Stoves or Furnaces for Drying and Heating' ('John and Jacob Drebble, and Abraham Kuffeler'). Oxford copy, Google scan.

BOOKS.title: The History of the Royal Society of London for Improving of Natural Knowledge, Vol. I
BOOKS.author: Birch, Thomas
BOOKS.note: #5811 priority 4. London, A. Millar 1756, vol. I (years 1660–1664; the text reads 'VOL. I'). Goddard 'suggested Drebbel's method'.

BOOKS.title: The History of the Royal Society of London for Improving of Natural Knowledge, Vol. II
BOOKS.author: Birch, Thomas
BOOKS.note: #5811 priority 4. London, A. Millar 1756, vol. II (years 1666–1672). 'Dr. Kuffler might be desired to give a perfect description of his new oven, both stationary and portable'; 'Dr. Keffler's brother'.

BOOKS.title: Relation d'un voyage en Angleterre, où sont touchées plusieurs choses qui regardent l'estat des sciences & de la religion & autres matieres curieuses
BOOKS.author: Sorbière, Samuel
BOOKS.note: #5811 priority 5. Cologne, Pierre Michel 1666 ([12], 192 p.), Columbia Seligman copy. A fallback for the Paris 1664 first edition (Gallica 429 from Hetzner). Has 'D'un fourneau de M. Kuffler, gendre de Drebbel'.

BOOKS.title: Oud Holland, jaargang 22 (1904)
BOOKS.author: Various
BOOKS.note: #5811 priority 7. The whole journal volume; Naber, 'Cornelis Jacobsz. Drebbel, 1572–1634' begins at printed p.195. The table of contents also lists 'Perpetuum Mobile van Cornelis Jacobsz. Drebbel, getoond aan Jacobus I ± 1604'. Google scan.
